cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

mechanism: Copy an editor's strike-through as emphasis, then use the limits of offered complaint help to redefine the helper as an editor rather than a representative.
confusable: Not any coauthor negotiation: B2 must expose the copied mark and A's confident reinterpretation must shape the assistance request.
comparison: Risk-limited colleague help instead of friends sharing physical labor.
seedUse: Retains complaint sentence, spelling help and names; introduces deletion-mark misunderstanding and B's unwillingness to sign.
